title: Evidence of high-mass star formation through multiscale mass accretion in hub-filament-system clouds
question: Gain insights into high-mass star formation scenarios in hub-filament-system (HFS) clouds by analysing their hierarchical structures (clouds, clumps, and cores), YSO clustering, and outflow feedback across an evolutionary sequence from IR-dark to IR-bright stages.

data.angular_resolution: ~1.2'' for ASHES (1.3 mm) and ~2.0'' for ATOMS (3 mm)
data.sensitivity: ~0.1 mJy beam^-1 at 1.3 mm (ASHES) and ~0.3 mJy beam^-1 at 3 mm (ATOMS)

recipe.goal: Measure central clump properties from ATLASGAL 870 um maps
recipe.method: Extract integrated 870 um flux within a uniform circular aperture of radius 0.25 pc centered on the enhanced 870 um emission, and compute clump mass and mass surface density using dust temperatures from literature.
assumptions: Gas-to-dust mass ratio R_gd = 100, dust opacity k_870um = 1.78 cm^2 g^-1

recipe.goal: Subtract free-free emission from 3 mm continuum for cores with compact HII regions
recipe.method: Estimate free-free continuum intensity from integrated H40alpha recombination line intensity and subtract it from the 3 mm continuum image for the five cores associated with compact HII regions.
assumptions: Local thermodynamical equilibrium, optically thin emission, electron temperature T_e = 6000 K, helium-to-hydrogen abundance N_He / N_H = 0.08

recipe.goal: Extract compact cores in the 9 IR-bright HFSs and adopt IR-dark cores from literature
recipe.method: Run the Dendrogram algorithm on the ATOMS 3 mm combined 12m+7m continuum data to identify leaf structures as cores, and adopt the 224 cores in the 8 IR-dark HFSs from Sanhueza et al. (2019).
key_parameters: intensity threshold = 2.5 sigma, step = 1.0 sigma, minimum pixels = 1 synthesized beam, integrated flux cut >= 4 sigma

recipe.goal: Classify star-forming nature of cores and derive core masses and surface densities
recipe.method: Cross-match cores with outflow, hot core, compact HII region, and 8/24 um point source associations, assign temperatures based on classification, and compute M_core and Sigma_core.
assumptions: T_dust = natal clump temperature for prestellar candidates, 50 K for outflow-associated cores, 100 K for hot core or compact HII region cores; dust opacity = 0.9 cm^2 g^-1 (1 mm) and 0.2 cm^2 g^-1 (3 mm); R_gd = 100.

recipe.goal: Identify, filter, classify, and estimate luminosities of candidate YSOs
recipe.method: Search Spitzer/MIPSGAL 24 um catalogue and perform manual aperture photometry for 10 uncatalogued bright sources, filter foreground/background stars using Gaia EDR3 parallaxes, cross-match with the SPICY IRAC YSO catalogue, and estimate L_bol from 24 um fluxes.
key_parameters: Search area 1.5'-4.8'; Gaia EDR3 matching radius = 2''; parallax distance filter > 10% difference from HFS distance; SPICY matching radius = 2''
assumptions: Empirical 24 um flux to L_bol correlation from Dunham et al. (2008) and Ragan et al. (2012).

recipe.goal: Analyze relative orientation of molecular outflows and hub-composing filaments
recipe.method: Compile positions and orientations of 60 outflow lobes from Li et al. (2020) and Baug et al. (2022, in prep.) and compare their directions with the hub-composing filaments seen in 8 um images.
